rows.name: Long Agentic
rows.focus: long-running work — applications extended over several turns of changing requirements, operations on an existing codebase over simulated months or weeks, and extended coding and optimisation tasks. Deterministic grading.

rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Long Agentic — 0-100 suite score, mean task score over the suite's 18 tasks; column 'long_agentic' in table.csv, also the table's first column when the suite is selected (?cats=Long%20Agentic) · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/table.csv

rows.notes: JS page (hash route; ?cats=<suite> selects the suite and sorts by it, per main.js); values from release 20261106 data files the page loads. Default view: one row per model, finetunes hidden. Weight in Overall per categories.json: 2.0.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L4 (Expert); bootstrap agreement: L4 100%.
